instructions.name: create
instructions.title: Create associated token account
instructions.rationale: Creates the wallet's associated token account for a mint; the funder pays rent and no tokens move. Fails if the account already exists.
instructions.notes: Tag 0 (Borsh enum variant index, treated as a 1-byte tag). Wire data is [00], or EMPTY (legacy form): processor.rs runs `if input.is_empty() { Create }` (already so in v1.0.5, when Create was the only variant), and the deprecated lib.rs builder (since 1.0.5) emits data=[] with a 7th rent-sysvar account that the program ignores. Empty data has no tag byte, so integrators and AgentAuth.verify must map it to disc8 0000000000000000 (rawPrefixHex does not match it). Still in use on mainnet-beta: in 24 sampled finalized mainnet-beta blocks (slots 455225190-455225201 and 455226399-455226410, 2026-10-10) 66 of 2,818 top-level ATA instructions had empty data, and all 21 empty-data ATA instructions in the second sample sat in successful transactions. The p-ATA rewrite keeps the alias (`[] | [0] => Create`, test empty_instruction_data_remains_create). Longer data is rejected (Borsh try_from_slice rejects trailing bytes). Accounts: 0 funder (w,s), 1 ata (w), 2 wallet, 3 mint, 4 system_program, 5 token_program. read_only follows SCHEMA.md, but it is not free: the funder pays rent (0.00148844 SOL for a 165-byte account per `solana rent 165 -u m` on 2026-10-10) into an account that the caller-chosen wallet fully owns, and there is no amount field to cap it, so constrain account 0 (funder) and account 2 (wallet) or cap SOL spend elsewhere.

instructions.name: create_idempotent
instructions.title: Create associated token account (idempotent)
instructions.rationale: Creates the associated token account only if missing and is a no-op when a valid one exists; the funder pays rent, no tokens move.
instructions.notes: Tag 1; wire data is exactly [01] (empty data is Create, not this). Returns Ok without spending when the ATA already exists with the right owner and mint; fails with InvalidOwner if the existing account has a different owner. Same accounts, rent-spend caveat and constraint advice as create (a 7th rent-sysvar account is ignored). By far the most common ATA instruction on mainnet-beta: 2,748 of 2,818 top-level ATA instructions in the 24 sampled finalized mainnet-beta blocks (slots 455225190-455225201 and 455226399-455226410, 2026-10-10).

instructions.name: recover_nested
instructions.title: Recover nested token account
instructions.rationale: Moves the entire balance of a nested associated token account to the wallet's own ATA, then closes it, sending lamports to the wallet.
instructions.notes: Tag 2; wire data is exactly [02]. The wallet (account 5) must sign. Moves the entire balance of the nested ATA to the wallet's own ATA for the nested mint (transfer_checked with the amount read from account state, so there is no amount in the instruction data), then closes the nested account and sends its lamports to the wallet. The destination token account is PDA-derived from the signing wallet and the lamports go to that wallet itself, so practical risk is low, but it closes an account and agents rarely need it, hence default deny. Accounts: 0 nested_ata (w), 1 nested_mint, 2 destination_ata (w), 3 owner_ata, 4 owner_mint, 5 wallet (w,s), 6 token_program. p-ATA (SIMD-0567, not deployed) extends it with multisig wallets, a separate nested token program and an optional 8th account; the tag is unchanged. No tag-2 instruction appeared in the 24 sampled finalized mainnet-beta blocks (slots 455225190-455225201 and 455226399-455226410, 2026-10-10).

instructions.name: create_with_args
instructions.title: Create associated token account (with args, p-ATA only)
instructions.rationale: p-ATA-only create with optional hints, not live yet; on Token-2022 the caller-set account_len can inflate the funder's rent, so deny by default.
instructions.notes: p-ATA-ONLY and NOT executable today. The binary at this id is the legacy Borsh build (BPF Loader v2, 105,032 bytes, sha256 6804554e69fd3a58caa191dc4a58f4c67223d30ca28ab8987f39fc18d2f7374d, byte-identical on mainnet-beta and devnet, dumped 2026-10-10): its ELF holds the Debug names Create, CreateIdempotent and RecoverNested but no CreateWithArgs, so a tag-3 call is expected to fail as invalid instruction data (not simulated). The instruction was added to the Pinocchio build in commit e613b7e010b904ca4fb1f191b492f43412d5eec5 (2026-05-14) and replacing the program is proposed in SIMD-0567 (status Review, feature TBD on 2026-10-10). Wire data is exactly 7 bytes: [03][mode u8: 0 Always, 1 Idempotent][bump u8: 0 none][account_len u32le at offset 3: 0 none]; disc8 is the tag zero-padded, never the raw bytes. amount describes account_len in bytes, not value: for Token-2022 the hint is used as the new account size without being compared to the mint's requirement (source comment: 'excessive sizes fail through rent/system account-size limits'), so the funder's rent is caller-inflatable and account_len should be capped. SPL Token ignores the hint (fixed 165 bytes). Accounts as create plus an optional 7th rent sysvar. No tag-3 instruction appeared in the 24 sampled finalized mainnet-beta blocks (slots 455225190-455225201 and 455226399-455226410, 2026-10-10). Keep denied until p-ATA is deployed and reviewed.
